premise_admission.mandatory: Caller supplies an implementation of ExclusiveOwnershipAuthority whose reserve returns ExclusiveAllocation. No production implementation or affirmative fixture implementation is supplied. None, bool, dict, missing verified executable, expired owner, refusing allocation all fail closed.
premise_admission.not_a_claim: This source does not establish exclusive ownership on this workstation. Folder names, root handles, file IDs and private bootstrap are not evidence that arbitrary same-account writers cannot modify child files.
premise_admission.required_evidence: Trusted deployment allocator must establish the actual exclusive operational premise: one exact owner/process generation for this fresh root; no concurrent untrusted writers to root, child files or relevant parent paths; controlled lifetime and shutdown; externally enforced deployment immutability. If deployment cannot establish that premise, reserve/revalidate must raise and launch stays refused. No ACL changes or token manipulation are implemented.
premise_admission.capability_contract: Allocation root and slot_count are immutable; revalidate(owner) must reject mismatched/revoked/unknown ownership and return None only for established exclusive ownership. reserve has strong exception semantics: if it raises it must retain/quarantine its own partially allocated resources rather than orphan them. release_after_cleanup must be idempotent and return None only on confirmed release.
premise_admission.crash: Parent-process crash closes OS handles; kill-on-close Job terminates the child but is not instantaneous path locking. External allocator must quarantine that root until actual process/Job disposal is independently established; never infer free root from parent disappearance. No arbitrary same-account adversary isolation claim.

handle_lifecycle: Validate all derived paths and require no whitespace in root before opening any handle. Allocator pre-creates User, Saved, Config, Config/Windows, SaveGames and User/Temp. Adapter makes no directories and changes no permissions.

Acquire actual GENERIC_READ directory handles without FILE_SHARE_DELETE, no-follow, for drive root, every ancestor, session root and each required directory; bounded to128 unique paths. Read each final DOS path, attributes and volume/file ID. Preserve every partially acquired handle immediately.

Retain/revalidate handles across suspended child creation, existing Job assignment, real PID/creation-time readback, private frame validation, resume/write, lifetime alive/exchange calls and shutdown. Parent handles are not added to inherited child handle list.

Existing child.stop must confirm Job active0, root signaled, private writer/thread complete and handle closure. Parent host route revocation must also succeed before directory release. Any unconfirmed process disposal or handle close keeps settings_records and capacity unavailable; cleanup reentry rejects.

Directory handles close deepest-first; failed closes retained for bounded retry. Allocation released only after handle cleanup. Allocation-release uncertainty retains capacity even though engine is already disposed. No destructor drops ownership silently.
